planned.name: ix_room_code
planned.rationale: Every join is a lookup by short room code; unique prevents duplicate codes.

planned.name: ix_room_activity
planned.rationale: Powers the 'recent rooms' list without scanning the whole collection.

planned.name: ix_stroke_replay
planned.rationale: The hot path: replay a room's strokes in order. Covers range queries on seq for incremental loading after a snapshot.

planned.name: ix_stroke_undo
planned.rationale: Per-user undo claims the newest active stroke belonging to that user. Descending seq lets the atomic findOneAndUpdate stop at the first hit.

planned.name: ix_stroke_tool
planned.rationale: Supports the tool-distribution aggregation without a collection scan.

planned.name: ix_stroke_time
planned.rationale: Supports the time-bucketed activity aggregation ($dateTrunc grouping).

planned.name: ix_snapshot_latest
planned.rationale: Fetches the newest snapshot for a room in a single index seek.

meta.title: Contribution breakdown by user
meta.question: Who drew how much in this room, and how often did they undo?
meta.notes: Uses $cond inside $group to count active and undone strokes in a single pass instead of issuing two queries.

meta.title: Tool usage mix
meta.question: Which tools dominate, and how complex is a typical stroke for each?
meta.notes: $addToSet collects the distinct palette per tool; supported by the ix_stroke_tool index.

meta.title: Drawing activity over time
meta.question: How did drawing intensity vary minute by minute?
meta.notes: $dateTrunc buckets timestamps server-side so no raw timestamps cross the wire.

meta.title: Stroke complexity distribution
meta.question: Are strokes mostly short taps or long freehand curves?
meta.notes: $bucket produces a histogram in the database; the equivalent in SQL needs a CASE expression per band.

meta.title: Colour palette in use
meta.question: Which colours carry the most ink on the active canvas?
meta.notes: Derives an 'ink' metric by multiplying stroke width by point count inside $sum.

meta.title: Content bounding box
meta.question: What canvas region actually contains drawing?
meta.notes: $min and $max over the precomputed bbox subdocument drive the 'fit to content' button without reading any point arrays.

meta.title: Room leaderboard (joined)
meta.question: Across all rooms, which are the busiest?
meta.notes: $lookup with a sub-pipeline aggregates strokes inside the join, demonstrating a referenced relationship without embedding.

meta.title: Single-request dashboard
meta.question: Can the whole analytics panel load in one query?
meta.notes: $facet evaluates four sub-pipelines over one matched set, replacing four separate round trips to the database.

meta.title: Storage footprint by tool
meta.question: How many bytes does each kind of stroke document cost?
meta.notes: $bsonSize measures real on-disk document size, which grounds the capacity estimate for 100k strokes.

undo_lookup.why: Behind every undo: the newest active stroke for one user. Sorted and limited to one document, so the index either seeks straight to it or the server sorts the whole room.

incremental_join.why: Joining a room that already has a snapshot: only strokes newer than the snapshot sequence are replayed.

history_metadata.why: Ordered pass over the whole room reading metadata only. The point arrays are projected away, so this isolates the cost of sorting.

tool_count.why: How many pen strokes exist in this room. A count never needs the documents themselves, so the index answers it outright.

covered_query.why: Every field requested is already in ix_stroke_tool, so the query is covered: MongoDB answers it from index keys and examines zero documents.
